message: No detected input validation: The code loads .npy files and passes arrays directly into datasets and the model with no shape, dtype, range, or schema checks anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from hardcoded local filesystem paths via np.load(); there is no remote source fetching, and therefore no checksum verification or authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no check for label distribution anomalies, validation of label values against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tool used anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code loads numpy arrays directly and splits them without any outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The checkpoint is loaded with torch.load(ck_pt_path) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; there is no integrity verification of any kind before loading the model weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop in engine.py performs no gradient anomaly detection, activation analysis, or any backdoor/trigger defense.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attacks (FGSM, PGD, Foolbox, ART, etc.) are applied anywhere in the evaluation or training code; a commented-out Gaussian noise addition is the only perturbation and it is disabled.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a separate test split is created via train_test_split, the test set is never evaluated in the shown code (only train/val loaders are used in engine.py), there is no data hashing or signing, and only a single loss metric (SmoothL1Loss) is reported without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: Inputs are loaded directly from .npy files and passed to the model via DataLoader with only a dtype cast (torch.float), with no shape, range, or schema validation.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are consumed directly in loss computation with no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or any other output validation before use.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision / image reconstruction pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
